reviewer: Codex exact degree-window, failure and source review

formal_specification.domain: Raw metadata label, i32 lower and upper endpoints, and arbitrary notes. No category or differential law is represented.
formal_specification.degree_span: Returns Some(u32(upper-lower)) iff lower<=upper; otherwise None. The span is a difference, not inclusive cardinality.
formal_specification.validation: Return first InvalidShape for an empty byte-string label, then for inverted endpoints; otherwise Ok. Validation borrows the raw record without changing it.
formal_specification.construction: new sets both endpoints to zero. with_degree_bounds stores the exact supplied endpoints. with_note appends without changing any existing field.

symbol_map.new: Raw label, zero endpoints and empty notes.
symbol_map.with_note: Append one converted note; retain the label and both endpoints.
symbol_map.degree_span: Ordered guard followed by exact standard-library unsigned abs_diff, or None for inversion.
symbol_map.validate_shell: Ordered, typed label/bounds guards followed by the sole Ok return.

invariant_argument: For i32 endpoints, lower>=-2^31 and upper<=2^31-1. On the ordered branch, 0<=upper-lower<=2^32-1; the checked DegreeWindow Lean model proves this bound. std i32::abs_diff represents that nonnegative integer in u32 without performing a signed subtraction.

On inversion the query returns None and shape validation returns the second typed error, unless the empty-label guard already returned the first. The separately checked ordered-predicate model and direct source-stage mapping establish no successful result after a required validation refusal.
All constructors return raw metadata, so invalid raw declarations are not silently promoted. No field is an admitted category or chain-complex certificate.

failure_paths.empty_label: InvalidShape("empty label"), tested as an exact typed payload.
failure_paths.inverted_bounds: degree_span None; validator InvalidShape with the actual signed endpoints in their original order.
failure_paths.overflow: The pre-fix checked i32 subtraction panicked for MIN..MAX. It is retained as an E-level historical witness. The replacement uses abs_diff after the order check.
failure_paths.allocation_and_conversion: Ordinary String/Vec allocation and caller-owned Into behavior are declared runtime boundaries; the arithmetic query itself allocates nothing.

trust_boundary.numeric: i32 and u32 representation and the exact std abs_diff contract under the pinned Rust compiler/runtime. No float, saturating approximation or narrowing signed subtraction is used.
trust_boundary.proof: Lean kernel, pinned Mathlib, standard foundational axioms only. The arithmetic/refusal models are not Rust/MIR refinement proofs.
trust_boundary.runtime: Safe Rust, standard String/Vec operations and serde-derived raw representation. No unsafe, production indexing or recursion.

consumer_review: The parent abelian module reexports a raw metadata type; its source, crate lib and Cargo manifest are pinned. No computed homology or category-law consumer may treat this shell as a mathematical certificate.
The compiled category package passes all 455 tests before and after the successful replays. Public validation now returns the crate existing typed ArithmosError rather than String.

G1: Source SHA, all five public symbols, exact numeric/metadata domain, current crate context, original witness and bound replay/proof receipts directly map the finite claim. AuthorityEffect remains None.
G2: All 49 pairs from signed extrema and near-zero endpoints agree with an independent i64 subtraction oracle; MIN..MAX returns u32::MAX. The Lean theorem proves the entire declared signed-domain span bound. Raw constructors preserve supplied endpoints and do not claim admission.
G3: The source contains no unchecked signed arithmetic in the repaired span path. Inverted bounds and empty labels are explicitly refused; validation preserves first typed errors and raw state. Checked arithmetic/refusal models and the source-stage argument cover every production exit under the declared std/runtime trust boundary.
G4: Seven designated semantic faults were killed in 20261018T234208Z. Its ambiguous DW05 text recipe remains invalid with the nonunique-site reason; it is never a kill.

The corrected DW09 unique-site candidate is killed in 20261018T235018Z. An earlier disk-refused DW09 attempt remains unrun; its candidate SHA equals the later killed candidate, explicitly resolving the missing execution without rewriting history.

Across the eight distinct eligible fault classes the conservative final detection fraction is 1.0: overflow, inverted span, inverted admission, false zero span, wrong typed error, changed endpoint binding, empty label bypass and lost note. All 455-test initial/restored baselines used for grading pass.
G5: All five production methods have bounded straight-line/branch structure within calibrated A source ceilings. The span/shape query is constant-time and nonrecursive, without allocation in an inner loop. Constructors move values, and note append has the ordinary amortized Vec bound. No benchmark or A+ resource contract is claimed.
